statBlock.name: Starlight Apparition
statBlock.description: A radiant image of someone who died in Wildspace or the Astral Sea. It reaches across the Astral Plane to help a living creature through a particular ordeal, then fades once its help is no longer needed.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold and fire. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Astral Existence. It can survive only on the Astral Plane. Sending it anywhere else destroys it.
Illumination. With 1 or more hit points, it casts bright light to 20 ft. and dim light another 20 ft.
Incorporeal Movement. The apparition treats objects and other creatures as difficult terrain when passing through them. Ending its turn inside an object deals it 5 (1d10) force damage.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Radiant Eruption. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Deal 20 (5d6 + 3) radiant damage on a hit. A creature hit must also pass a DC 14 Wisdom save or be blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat that save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
Possession (Recharge 6). Choose one Humanoid the apparition can see within 5 ft. On a failed DC 14 Charisma save, the apparition vanishes into the target and takes control. The target stays aware but becomes incapacitated and cannot control its body. Attacks, spells and other effects cannot target the apparition directly. It keeps its own alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma, and its immunity to being charmed or frightened. Otherwise use the host’s statistics, without access to its knowledge, class features or proficiencies.
The possession ends if the host drops to 0 hit points or leaves the Astral Plane, if the apparition spends a bonus action to leave, or if an effect such as Dispel Evil and Good forces it out. It returns to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the host and is destroyed if that space lies outside the Astral Plane. After a successful initial save or the end of a possession, the target is immune to this apparition’s Possession for 24 hours.

statBlock.name: Thri-kreen Gladiator
statBlock.description: An arena fighter eager to test its weapons and reflexes. Some mark their carapaces with the blood of their foes.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gythka attacks and one Chatkcha attack.
Gythka. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. Roll the attack with advantage while the gladiator is below its hit point maximum.
Chatkcha. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. Roll the attack with advantage while the gladiator is below its hit point maximum.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Jump up to 20 ft. in any direction while the gladiator has a speed above 0.
sections.Reactions: Parry. If a visible attacker would hit it with a melee attack while it is wielding a melee weapon, the gladiator raises its AC by 3 against that attack.

statBlock.name: Thri-kreen Hunter
statBlock.description: A forager and tracker with a color-changing shell. In Wildspace it might pursue a fugitive or head up a pirate gang.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with Gythka or Chatkcha.
Gythka. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.
Chatkcha. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Chameleon Carapace. The hunter adjusts the color of its shell to match the surroundings’ color and texture. It gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in those surroundings.
Leap. With a speed above 0, the hunter can jump up to 20 ft. in any direction.
sections.Reactions: Parry. While holding a melee weapon, the hunter can add 2 to its AC against a melee attack that would hit it. The attacker must be visible to it.

statBlock.name: Thri-kreen Mystic
statBlock.description: A psionic adept who levitates over obstacles and drains life from prey. Mystics often act as pilots aboard thri-kreen spelljamming ships.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make either two Gythka attacks or four Psychic Bolt attacks.
Gythka. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d8 + 1) slashing damage.
Psychic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) psychic damage.
Drain Vitality (recharges on a short or long rest). Choose a creature the mystic can see within 30 ft. It makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 32 (5d12) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. The mystic heals for the damage it actually deals.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one spell from the list using Wisdom and no components.
At will: Levitate (self only), Mage Hand (the hand is invisible).
1/day each: Freedom of Movement and Invisibility (both self only).
sections.Bonus actions: Chameleon Carapace. The mystic changes the color of its shell to match the surroundings’ color and texture. It rolls Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide there with advantage.

statBlock.name: Vampirate
statBlock.description: A gaunt undead pirate who steals life energy by touch or at a distance. Some sleep in coffins filled with grave dirt or make do among cargo in the hold.

sections.Traits:
Explode. Reaching 0 hit points blasts nearby creatures with ash. Every creature within 5 ft. must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or take 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.
Spider Climb. It can scale difficult surfaces and cross ceilings without an ability check.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air or drink.
sections.Actions:
Energy Drain. Melee or ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. A hit deals 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid that drops to 0 hit points from this attack dies and immediately rises as a free-willed Shadow run by the DM.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Crew: A vampirate crew may keep one or more Shadows of its former victims aboard.

statBlock.name: Vampirate Captain
statBlock.description: An undead raider who can conceal an entire ship. Its temperament sets the tone aboard, from strict codes of conduct to attacks that leave no survivors.

sections.Traits:
Explode. At 0 hit points the captain bursts into ash. Every creature within 5 ft. must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.
Spider Climb. Difficult walls and ceilings require no ability check to climb.
Unusual Nature. The captain needs no air or drink.
sections.Actions:
Energy Drain. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. A hit deals 22 (4d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid this reduces to 0 hit points dies and immediately rises as a free-willed Shadow or Vampirate, chosen by the captain and run by the DM.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Ship Invisibility (recharges on a short or long rest). While standing aboard a ship, the captain can make it and everything aboard invisible to anyone outside it. The magic lasts up to 1 hour with Concentration, as with a spell. It ends immediately if the captain leaves the ship.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attacker the captain can see hits it with an attack, the captain halves that attack’s damage against itself.
sections.Companions: A Crawling Claw or Will-o'-Wisp often accompanies the captain.
sections.Encounter context: The ship table puts Captain Veluna Valderak aboard the hammerhead Jander Sunstar with 13 Vampirates and one Priest.
